body.text: MATERIALITY MEMO FY2026. Overall annual materiality $160,000 (5% of budgeted pretax income of $3.2M). Quarterly performance materiality $60,000. Clearly trivial threshold $8,000: items below this are logged, not booked individually. Flux commentary threshold: variance greater than 10% AND greater than $25,000 versus prior quarter or budget (company policy; common practice, no published standard). Cash forecast tolerance $2,500 per week. Qualitative overrides: anything affecting covenant compliance, a bonus tier, or the sign of a reported change is material regardless of size (SAB 99 factors).
body.title: FY2026 Materiality Memo (Dana Ortiz, Controller)
